title: Flock Fighter
normal: Attack speed +4% while your current target is an ordinary monster.
nightmare: Attack speed +5% while your current target is an ordinary monster.

title: Night School
normal: Job EXP from kills +5%.
nightmare: Job EXP from kills +6.25%.

title: Fade
normal: After dodging, take 8% less damage from the next hit within 3 seconds.
nightmare: After dodging, take 10% less damage from the next hit within 3 seconds.

title: Grave Pact
normal: Magic damage +6%; healing received −8%.
nightmare: Magic damage +7.5%; healing received −8%.

title: Ancient Grip
normal: Normal-attack damage against rooted enemies +6%.
nightmare: Normal-attack damage against rooted enemies +7.5%.

title: Heavy Steps
normal: Max HP +4%; movement speed −2%.
nightmare: Max HP +5%; movement speed −2%.

title: Magic Shell
normal: MDEF +8.
nightmare: MDEF +10.

title: Dust Cloak
normal: Take 4% less physical damage while above 70% HP.
nightmare: Take 5% less physical damage while above 70% HP.

title: Hard Carapace
normal: DEF +6% while stationary and engaged with a target.
nightmare: DEF +7.5% while stationary and engaged with a target.

title: Burrow Guard
normal: After travelling 5 units, gain a shield worth 2% Max HP for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
nightmare: After travelling 5 units, gain a shield worth 2.5% Max HP for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

title: Dancer's Grace
normal: After casting a damaging skill, gain 4 Flee points for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds.
nightmare: After casting a damaging skill, gain 5 Flee points for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds.

title: Scrap Dealer
normal: Zeny from manually sold equipment +6%.
nightmare: Zeny from manually sold equipment +7.5%.

title: Unyielding Flesh
normal: Take 3% less damage from ordinary monsters.
nightmare: Take 3.75% less damage from ordinary monsters.

title: Water Reserve
normal: Healing from your own skills +5%.
nightmare: Healing from your own skills +6.25%.

title: Forager
normal: Base EXP from normal-monster kills +5%.
nightmare: Base EXP from normal-monster kills +6.25%.

title: Threaded Strikes
normal: First normal hit after switching targets deals 8% more damage. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
nightmare: First normal hit after switching targets deals 10% more damage. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

title: Sting
normal: Normal hits have a 10% chance to poison the target for 12% ATK total over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 3 seconds; refreshes, never stacks.
nightmare: Normal hits have a 10% chance to poison the target for 15% ATK total over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 3 seconds; refreshes, never stacks.

title: Piercing Sting
normal: Critical normal attacks ignore 5% of target DEF.
nightmare: Critical normal attacks ignore 6.25% of target DEF.

title: Profane Study
normal: Damaging magic skills deal 4% more damage while above 80% HP.
nightmare: Damaging magic skills deal 5% more damage while above 80% HP.

title: Branching Magic
normal: Area-of-effect magic skills deal 4% more damage to each target hit.
nightmare: Area-of-effect magic skills deal 5% more damage to each target hit.

title: Long Shot
normal: Normal attacks from at least 4 units away deal 4% more damage.
nightmare: Normal attacks from at least 4 units away deal 5% more damage.

title: Covering Fire
normal: Critical normal attacks from at least 4 units away deal 5% more final damage.
nightmare: Critical normal attacks from at least 4 units away deal 6.25% more final damage.

title: Battle Roar
normal: After defeating an MVP, gain 6% attack speed for 10 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.
nightmare: After defeating an MVP, gain 7.5% attack speed for 10 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.

title: Funeral Rite
normal: Defeating an MVP restores 8% Max HP.
nightmare: Defeating an MVP restores 10% Max HP.

title: Front Line
normal: Physical skill damage +5% while at least two enemies are within 3 units.
nightmare: Physical skill damage +6.25% while at least two enemies are within 3 units.

title: Desert Resolve
normal: Damage +4% while below 50% HP.
nightmare: Damage +5% while below 50% HP.

title: Heavy Blow
normal: Single-target physical skills deal 4% more damage.
nightmare: Single-target physical skills deal 5% more damage.

title: Pursuit
normal: After killing your current target, gain 6% movement speed for 4 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.
nightmare: After killing your current target, gain 7.5% movement speed for 4 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.

title: Companion Lesson
normal: Pet damage against normal monsters +4%.
nightmare: Pet damage against normal monsters +5%.

title: Oni Strength
normal: Physical damage +5%; take 3% more damage.
nightmare: Physical damage +6.25%; take 3% more damage.

title: Cold Focus
normal: Single-target magic skills ignore 6% of target MDEF.
nightmare: Single-target magic skills ignore 7.5% of target MDEF.

title: Fortress
normal: Take 5% less damage while below 30% HP.
nightmare: Take 6.25% less damage while below 30% HP.

title: River Shield
normal: Take 5% less damage from MVP normal attacks.
nightmare: Take 6.25% less damage from MVP normal attacks.

title: Life Siphon
normal: A single-target physical skill hit restores 0.5% Max HP. Cooldown: 4 seconds; subject to the shared leech cap.
nightmare: A single-target physical skill hit restores 0.625% Max HP. Cooldown: 4 seconds; subject to the shared leech cap.

title: Foxfire
normal: Every fifth damaging magic skill burns its primary target for 15% MATK total over 3 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.
nightmare: Every fifth damaging magic skill burns its primary target for 18.75% MATK total over 3 seconds. Refreshes; does not stack.

title: Wild Magic
normal: Every sixth damaging magic skill deals 15% extra damage.
nightmare: Every sixth damaging magic skill deals 18.75% extra damage.

title: Deep Scavenger
normal: Nightmare material drop chance +5% relative to its base rate.
nightmare: Nightmare material drop chance +6.25% relative to its base rate.

title: Molten Skin
normal: When hit, burn the attacker for 10% ATK total over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds; cannot trigger other card effects.
nightmare: When hit, burn the attacker for 12.5% ATK total over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds; cannot trigger other card effects.
